dash.title: Overview
dash.subtitle: How the server is doing right now
upd.title: Updates
upd.subtitle: The whole system updates at once; if something goes wrong, you can go back to the previous version.
upd.channel_text: Changing the channel: the system will download the version from the selected channel and offer to install it. Beta versions come earlier but may have bugs.
upd.settings_hint: Automatic installs and reboots happen only in the maintenance window and only when nobody is watching anything.
upd.apply_now_text: The server will install the update and reboot. Playback on all devices will stop for a few minutes.
upd.scheduled: The update will be installed in the maintenance window.
upd.rollback_text: The server will reboot into the previous system version ({v}). Your files and settings stay as they are.
upd.rolling_back: Going back to the previous version and rebooting…
upd.rollback_queued: After a reboot the server will start the previous system version.
upd.about_text: The new version is installed next to the current one and takes over after a reboot. If it fails to boot, the server goes back to the previous one by itself. The media library, users and settings are stored separately and do not change.
reboot.title: Rebooting
reboot.hint: This page reopens by itself when the server is back. It usually takes 1–3 minutes.
reboot.timeout: The server has not answered for a long time. Check that it is on and reload the page.

users.short_password: The password is shorter than 8 characters.
users.footer: The same name and password open the shared folders from computers and phones.

share.subtitle: Access to the server's files from computers on the local network
share.guest_hint: The “media” folder opens without signing in, read-only.
share.tm_hint: Mac computers can keep backups on the server.
share.how: On Windows, open the address in File Explorer; on macOS, Finder → Connect to Server (smb://…).
ssh.confirm: Allow SSH sign-in from the local network? Only key sign-in will work.

adv.title: Advanced mode
adv.subtitle: For those who know Linux
adv.cockpit_text: Cockpit is a full Linux control panel: terminal, storage, logs, containers. Changes made there can break what Kinolune OS sets up.
adv.lan_only: Works only from the local network. Cockpit is not reachable from the internet.
adv.open_port: Open Cockpit on the local network
adv.not_running: Cockpit starts by itself on the first visit to port 9090.
adv.no_blur_hint: Solid panels without blur: faster on weak computers.
adv.api_text: Everything this interface can do is available through the REST API, described in OpenAPI format.
